Short sizing & pricing readout based on their stated steady/peak volumes:

Recommended commit tiers (annualized):
- S1: 6M tokens/year (~500k/mo) — List: $72,000/year
- S2 (recommended): 18M tokens/year (~1.5M/mo) — List: $194,400/year
- S3: 60M tokens/year (~5M/mo) — List: $600,000/year

If we apply a steady-state vs peak pricing model, peaks beyond committed tokens are billed at +30% on marginal rate. For their steady ~1.5M/mo, S2 covers comfortably; peak surges would use burst capacity.

Margin & discount guardrails:
- Standard discounts up to 15% are OK via Sales Ops.
- Discounts between 15–25% require Sales Manager approval (Evelyn).
- >25% must go to Revenue Ops and Legal for commercial exceptions.

If VectorAI wants ~20%, that is within the 15–25% window: needs your approval, Evelyn. Also note: onboarding/eval credit should be treated as one-time non-recurring credit against first invoice, tracked by CS. Recommend a cap at $25k unless Evelyn approves higher.

I'll attach a short pricing roll-up with monthly breakdowns for S2 (see Pricing_Rollup.xlsx).

—Marcus
